## Time clips

Drawn from scratch for any frame. Runnable in the player and in Remotion.

| Name | Id | Description | Modes | Tags | Links |
|------|----|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Mouth | `mouth` | Twenty horizontal curve lines on near-black, a base for line displacement. | **wave**: Lines ripple like a flag.<br>**pinch**: Lines part around a centre band, a mouth opening and closing.<br>**draw**: Lines plot left to right, one after another. | lines, minimal | `?artwork=mouth`<br>`?clip=mouth` |
| Space Time | `spacetime` | Grid of scribble cells whose density falls across the page, black ink on white. | **drift**: Scribble points wander inside each cell.<br>**boil**: Every cell re-scribbles on twos.<br>**reveal**: Each scribble draws on, densest first. | scribble, lines | `?artwork=spacetime`<br>`?clip=spacetime` |
| Recursive Squares | `recursive-squares` | Nested rounded squares packed recursively, colour drifting with depth. | **grow**: Squares appear depth by depth.<br>**drift**: Each square wobbles relative to its parent. | geometric, recursive | `?artwork=recursive-squares`<br>`?clip=recursive-squares` |
| Samsara | `samsara` | Recursive circle packing in a randomly chosen palette. | **pack**: Circles pop in, parents before children.<br>**breathe**: Radii pulse, offset by depth.<br>**orbit**: Children revolve inside their parent. | geometric, recursive, color | `?artwork=samsara`<br>`?clip=samsara` |
| Tarkata | `tarkata` | One tangled thread walking a moving window across the page. | **thread**: The single line draws itself along its path.<br>**drift**: Every point wanders on a small loop.<br>**boil**: The whole thread re-rolls on twos. | lines, scribble | `?artwork=tarkata`<br>`?clip=tarkata` |
| Mesh | `mesh` | Low-poly crystal field of jittered triangles. | **breathe**: Vertices drift on seamless noise.<br>**shimmer**: Triangles re-roll colour on twos.<br>**reveal**: Triangles appear in a diagonal sweep. | geometric, texture | `?artwork=mesh`<br>`?clip=mesh` |

## Step clips

Simulations and paint that build up on the canvas. Runnable.

| Name | Id | Description | Modes | Tags | Links |
|------|----|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Fire | `fire` | ASCII fire with heat bands in pink, yellow, green and cyan. | **burn**: Neon heat bands: pink, yellow, green, cyan.<br>**ember**: One ink colour, brighter with heat. | ascii, simulation | `?artwork=fire`<br>`?clip=fire` |
| Her | `her` | Grid of layered translucent paint blobs bleeding into watercolour. | **bleed**: Paint builds up layer by layer, then holds.<br>**smear**: Blob centres creep while painting, leaving trails. | paint, color | `?artwork=her`<br>`?clip=her` |
| Arima | `arima` | Large overlapping paint blobs fusing into one dense glowing field. | **bleed**: Paint builds up layer by layer, then holds.<br>**smear**: Blob centres creep while painting, leaving trails. | paint, color | `?artwork=arima`<br>`?clip=arima` |
| Walker | `walker` | Random walkers sketching warm-palette curves. | **trails**: Lines accumulate forever.<br>**fade**: Old trail fades out; works over transparency. | lines, simulation | `?artwork=walker`<br>`?clip=walker` |
| Physarum | `physarum` | A slime-mould simulation spreads across paper in coloured ink, then a colour wave runs outward through it. | **bloom**: One source spreads outward, with a second mass far away, then one wave.<br>**colonies**: Two sources in two inks spread until they meet, without mixing, then one wave.<br>**veins**: A fully grown network with a colour wave that loops. | simulation, paint, organic | `?artwork=physarum`<br>`?clip=physarum` |

## Effects

Looks applied to an input image. Open `?effect=<id>` and drop in a picture. See [effects.md](effects.md).

| Name | Id | Description | Modes | Tags | Links |
|------|----|-------------|-------|------|-------|
| Patchwork | `patchwork` | Random square tiles over the picture, each tile showing it through a different effect. | **still**: One fixed layout. Use it for a single image.<br>**both**: Tiles change effect on a beat and hop to new grid slots.<br>**swap**: Tiles stay put and change effect on a staggered beat.<br>**shuffle**: Tiles keep their effect and hop to free grid slots. | collage, tiles, print | `?effect=patchwork` |
| Dither 1-bit | `dither-1bit` | Two-colour ordered dither with Bayer, clustered-dot or blue-noise matrices. | **still**: Static dither.<br>**boil**: The matrix jumps to a new offset on twos, like film grain.<br>**drift**: The pattern crawls across the picture. | dither, print, retro | `?effect=dither-1bit` |
| Halftone Dots | `halftone-dots` | Angled dot screen in one ink on paper, dots swell in the shadows. | **still**: Static dot screen.<br>**rotate**: The screen turns a quarter turn per loop. | print, texture | `?effect=halftone-dots` |
| Pixel Posterize | `pixel-posterize` | Chunky pixel blocks cut to a few colour levels, in source colours or one ink. | **still**: Static pixel blocks.<br>**reveal**: Blocks start huge and shrink to fine pixels. | pixel, retro, color | `?effect=pixel-posterize` |
| Ink Threshold | `ink-threshold` | The picture cut to one flat ink on paper, with a wobbly riso-style edge and grain. | **still**: Static cut.<br>**breathe**: The cut level swells and falls, so shapes grow and shrink.<br>**boil**: The wobble re-rolls on twos. | print, ink | `?effect=ink-threshold` |
| ASCII Glyph | `ascii-glyph` | Text characters picked by tone, dense glyphs in the shadows, in one ink or source colours. | **still**: Static text.<br>**scramble**: Glyphs flicker as random characters, then lock into the picture left to right. | ascii, text, retro | `?effect=ascii-glyph` |
| Contour Lines | `contour-lines` | Tone contour lines and edge strokes in one ink, like a topographic map of the picture. | **still**: Static contours.<br>**crawl**: Contour lines creep across the tones and loop.<br>**boil**: The line levels jump on twos. | lines, print | `?effect=contour-lines` |
| Mesh Grid | `mesh-grid` | A fine woven line grid whose threads thicken in the shadows. | **still**: Static mesh.<br>**drift**: The mesh slides across the picture and loops. | lines, texture | `?effect=mesh-grid` |
| Stipple | `stipple` | Scattered ink dots, more and bigger in the shadows, like pen-and-ink stippling. | **still**: Static dots.<br>**boil**: Every dot re-rolls its position on twos. | dots, ink, texture | `?effect=stipple` |
| Wave Lines | `wave-lines` | Horizontal wavy lines that thicken in the shadows, a line-screen portrait. | **still**: Static lines.<br>**ripple**: The waves travel along the lines and loop. | lines, print | `?effect=wave-lines` |
| Slice Glitch | `slice-glitch` | Horizontal bands slide sideways with an RGB split, a torn-signal look in source colours. | **still**: Static tear.<br>**jitter**: The bands re-roll on twos. | glitch, color | `?effect=slice-glitch` |
